record.field: # Smart Sync for Contact Data # Expected payload format: # { # "external_id": "string", # required - external system ID # "patient_id": "string", # backwards compatibility - external ID # "name": "string", # required - Full name # "phone": "string", # Phone number (628123456789) # "mobile": "string", # Mobile number (628123456789) # "email": "string", # Email address # "street": "string", # Street address # "city": "string", # City # "state_name": "string", # State name (e.g., "Jawa Tengah") # "date_of_birth": "date" # Date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD) # } if payload: result = model.smart_sync(payload) action = result else: raise UserError("No payload provided in context")

# Smart Sync for Product Data # Expected payload format: # { # "name": "string", # required - Product name # "default_code": "string", # Internal reference (SKU) # "barcode": "string", # Product barcode # "list_price": "float", # Sales price # "type": "string", # Product type (service, consu, product) # "categ_name": "string", # Category name (e.g., "Services", "Products") # }
if payload: result = model.smart_sync(payload) action = result else: raise UserError("No payload provided in context")

if payload: result = model.smart_sync(payload) action = result else: raise UserError("No payload provided in context")
